title: Turning an Action Into a Noun
goal: Turn a verb clause into a noun phrase to leave the doer out.
grammar: Nominalisation to leave out the doer

items: I can turn a verb clause into a noun phrase, as in la subida de los precios.
I can use the endings -ida, -miento, -ción and -o to form nouns from verbs.
I can use the new words for rises, arrivals, changes and growth.
